name: Ablative Coating
effect: A heat dispersing coat, layered upon the armor, that increases armor against laser and other heat-based weaponry by 20%.

name: Auto-Injector
effect: On the press of a button, detection of a certain type of stress or a similar trigger, this mod introduces a prepared dosage of an injection-type chemical into the wearer's bloodstream. Can hold up to 3 cartridges.

name: Auto-Loader
effect: A reload assistance system added to the outer thighs which halves reload times for magazine-fed pistols (without the \emph{Single Loader} rule). When present on both legs, this will allow reloading both guns while dual wielding.

name: Booster Sheath
effect: A melee weapon can be draw from this sheath in a free action. When combined with Quick Draw a weapon draw from this sheath can be combined with one non-flurry attack as a free action. When the armor mod is also powered, this attack gains 4 damage.

name: Brace Assist
effect: The character may brace as a free action. Moving still stops bracing.

name: CBRN (Helmet)
effect: A hazard prevention system containing a CBRN unit, rebreather and redundancies for each subsystem.

name: Cigarette Lighter Adapter
effect: Adds an outlet to light cigarettes on.

name: Deafen Suppressor
effect: Grants +20 to tests to resist deafening and disorientation. Grants -5 to auditory perception.

name: Discardable Plate
effect: Adds an outer layer that can be discarded easily. Useful when on fire or drenched in acid. When hit by a weapon with \emph{Rending}, the plate is destroyed, but the armor is unharmed.

name: Energy Rotella
effect: Projects a small shield over the user's arm that can be used to cover one location in addition to the arm it's attached to. Has 12 armor and a threshold of 7.

name: Faraday Cage
effect: Reduces EMP duration by 8 rounds and grants +30 to resist electricity-related Stun rules.

name: Final Hour Chip
effect: Once the wearer's vital signs cease, the armor self-destructs violently, dealing damage like a 40mm thermite grenade, except with a 6m Blast radius instead. Requires a vital monitor.

name: Flare Launcher
effect: Turns Vehicle Lock-on bonuses into penalties. Has 3 flares and takes a minute to refill.

name: Flash Visor
effect: Adds flash glass goggles to the helmet.

name: Flashlight
effect: Adds a flashlight and its related bonuses, without the need to use your hands. Hitting the location the active flashlight is attached to is at no penalty for low light or location.

name: Ghillie
effect: Adds a Ghillie Cloak to the armor, offering a +20 Bonus to Camouflage when used in matching surroundings.

name: Grappling Hook
effect: Adds a reusable grappling hook to the armor. Works like an integrated crossbow using grappling hook ammunition.\\ This is a very niche upgrade, as the grappling hook requires power but can only hold up to 250 kg of weight.

name: HUD
effect: Adds a heads up display to the helmet visor. Can be wired to display basically any device, but does not come with input peripherals.

name: Inertia Dampeners
effect: A marvel of technology allowing rapid changes in velocity. Fall damage is reduced and the Trauma rule is ignored. Depending on the situation this may have other bonuses, e.g. in fast vehicles.

name: Tacpad
effect: Adds a data pad the the armor's forearm.

name: Integrated Weapon
effect: Any one-handed melee or pistol type weapon can be affixed to an arm. Pistols now use Ranged Combat Training (Integrated Weaponry). One-handed melee weapons may use Melee Combat Training (Striking) or their normal skill depending on how they are installed.\\ Removes the Inconspicuous rule.

name: Intercom
effect: An inbuilt communication device using very strong encryption. Different intercoms need to be grouped at a computing device equipped for the task before being able to communicate among each other safely.

name: Jump Pack
effect: A backpack-like armor attachment containing boosters to increase jump height, leap length, allow some amount of control in the air or stop hitting the floor at a violently rapid pace. Requires Pilot (Jetpack) to steer.\\ Height: increases the jump height by a factor of 3, reduced by 0.5 for every full 100 kg the wearer weighs, becoming useless at 400kg\\ Control: can decrease fall damage by 4 dice, reduced by 1 for every full 100 kg the wearer weighs, becoming useless at 400kg\\ Ground Slam: doubles fall damage but enables a Charge with a speed of 10 times meters fallen and Blast (1)

name: Medic Container
effect: Fits one pack of wound sealant foam or wound dressing, a field surgery or stitch kit, 5 doses of any medicine and a thermal blanket. Any equipment stored here can be drawn as a free action.

name: Medical HUD
effect: When a patient has an accessible vital monitor, this device gives much more detailed information, thereby improving medical tests by +20.

name: Nanomesh Undersuit
effect: The minimum armor the wearer can be reduced to (by e.g. maneuvers) is 8 in any location that is covered by the modded piece of armor.

name: Night Vision
effect: A night vision device included in the helmet.

name: Odysseus Nav System
effect: A display that includes many forms of navigation systems, granting a +10 to driving and +20 to navigation tests.

name: Oversized Mag Holster
effect: Hooks to hold a taped or drum mag

name: Photo-Reactive Panels
effect: While powered, the armor will automatically match the surroundings. This grants the same benefits as the \emph{Ghillie} armor mod.

name: Piezoelectric Exo-Frame
effect: Carries the armor's weight.\\ When struck by an EMP, it grants a -20 penalty to all physical actions taken and deals D10+6 damage ignoring armor to all the wearer's locations every round.

name: Power Pack
effect: Adds a generator to non-powered armor to accommodate armor mods requiring power.

name: Radar
effect: A small radar device detecting moving objects in the vicinity. Detecting someone sneaking around is at a +40 bonus. Has a range of 40m.

name: Servo Exo-Frame
effect: A replacement for the more prevalent piezoelectric exo-frame. It is less potent, carrying only 3/4 of the armor's weight but won't harm the wearer in case of an EMP and instead just shut off.

name: Spring Charge (arm)
effect: Increases Strength for quick tasks like punching or throwing by 20.

name: Spring Charge (leg)
effect: Increases Strength for quick tasks like jumping or kicking by 20.

name: Temperature Regulators
effect: Tries to keep the armor's internals at around room temperature, preventing heat stroke and hypothermia in all but the harsh wastelands.

name: TROPHY ADS
effect: The TROPHY Active Defense System shoots projectiles out of the air that travel at least 5m/s, are between 2cm and 10cm across and within 10m of the wearer. Explosives are usually just destroyed while incendiaries still spill. Holds 6 cartridges of 11.8x45mm ammo and takes a minute to refill.

name: Up-Armor
effect: Additional armor plates that increase the location's armor by 1.

name: Vacuum Seal
effect: Seals the armor to prevent any gas leaking, like air flowing outside or hydrogen cyanide inside.

name: Vital Monitor
effect: Tracks the wearer's vital data. A abbreviation can be made accessible over network.
